args.subject: Regarding your data-residency region and refund request
args.body:
Hello Adatum Ltd,

We are processing your ticket regarding an incorrect data-residency region and a refund for the failed migration fee.

Regarding the data-residency region: our contract system currently shows your region as 'us-east'. Could you please confirm what region you believe should be set according to your contract? This will help us correct it promptly.

Thank you.
